Junaid specializes in Android development, primarily utilizing Kotlin and Java. His portfolio features two key Android projects:

Edugate is a virtual classroom application built for real-time video conferencing, screen sharing, and resource management. 

Ai assistant app is an on-screen AI interface designed for seamless user interaction within the Android environment. 

You can explore his source code and contributions further on his GitHub at https://github.com/junaidmirr.
